prompt:
Subject: Flexible Beauty in White Boots

Main Subject:
Place the figure large in the center of the frame. A full-body vertical photo of a woman in a bright pink room extending one leg straight up behind her head and holding the ankle high. White platform long boots and a pale pink outfit create a vertically long silhouette.

Person/Expression:
Face directed forward, gazing at the camera with a soft smile and closed mouth. Small oval face, almond-shaped eyes, thin eyebrows, a neat short nose, and pale coral lips. Long dark brown hair with thin bangs flowing to the shoulders, with slightly spreading ends.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale pink thin-strap cropped top with silver bead embroidery and shirring at the chest. A short asymmetrical white and pink ruffled skirt with long ruffles hanging from one side. Stand straight on the supporting leg, lift the other leg vertically from behind, and support the ankle of the white enamel platform long boots with a hand overhead. The other hand lightly holds the ends of the hair.

Background/Light:
A sofa on the left, a door on the right, a pink wall in the background, with soft main light coming from a window on the left. A round white sofa on the left, a decorative framed door on the right, pale pink walls and carpet. Strong morning sun shines from the left window, casting diagonal light on the wall and floor.

Composition/Camera:
Focus the camera on the person, fitting the whole body in the frame and naturally blurring the background. Show the person large in the center. 3:4 vertical composition, a full-body shot including everything from the boots on the floor to the boots at the top without cropping. Position the person in the center, extending the straight line of the extremely raised leg to the top of the frame. Shoot from a natural height close to the front.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photo. A bright and glamorous live-action portrait. High-definition representation of enamel reflections, beads, ruffles, and soft carpet.

Negative:
Do not lower the raised leg; do not omit the white long boots.
